build_dictionary_from_tokens: build a dictionary from a list of whitespace-separated tokens using input and output flags
build_dictionary_with_choe_charniak: build a dictionary converting input trees to Choe-Charniak representation before processing
build_dictionary_with_extra_closing: build a dictionary including an extra untyped closing non-terminal for Choe-Charniak inputs
build_dictionary_validate_balanced: build a dictionary that validates opening and closing non-terminal counts match
build_dictionary_output_metadata: build a dictionary and write token list with metadata JSON describing token counts
